summary: Intermittent analytics-portal RBAC drop after AD->Okta SCIM sync changes service-account group attributes
description: Issue summary: Several engineers reported losing access to the internal analytics portal (grafana-like UI) during a batch Okta group sync. Impact: Affected users (including service accounts used by scheduled queries) received 403s and saw their role badges removed in the console. Scope appears limited to users whose Okta profiles were updated by the AD->Okta bridge during a scheduled sync window. No database or data loss observed; only UI access and API token impersonation affected.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Trigger AD->Okta SCIM sync that updates group membership for users with department attribute changes
2) Immediately attempt to access analytics portal or call the portal's token-exchange endpoint using an affected user/service account
3) Observe 403 responses and missing role claims in the portal session; portal access is restored after group-cache refresh (~5-12 minutes) or manual admin re-provisioning
logs: auth-proxy WARN 2026-03-10T02:14:31Z missing role claim for user uid=eng-ml-074; token-exchange rejected (403)
scim-sync INFO 2026-03-10T02:13:58Z applied 42 group membership changes from AD delta; changed attribute 'memberOf' -> 'oktaGroups' mapping
identity-cache DEBUG 2026-03-10T02:14:40Z cache miss for uid=svc-query-12; falling back to realtime lookup that returned pre-sync group set
portal-api ERROR 2026-03-10T02:15:02Z authorization failed: role_lookup returned empty for uid=eng-ml-074
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: SCIM delta applied a mapping that temporarily cleared the role claim used by the portal's RBAC middleware during the same window the identity-cache TTL was being refreshed.

Observed a race between our scim-sync worker (writes Okta group attributes) and identity-cache invalidation job; cache eviction was scheduled but the downstream role-mapper reads stale state or missing transient claim until Okta asserts new group membership.

Reproduced in staging by forcing concurrent SCIM updates + cache eviction. When SCIM update writes new 'oktaGroups' attribute as an empty list then immediately repopulates, our role-mapper sees the transient empty value and strips roles.
Affected principals include both human users and service accounts created via JIT provisioning; service accounts experience failed token-exchange flows for scheduled jobs.
No evidence of changes to RBAC policy config in the portal itself; root cause localized to identity sync + cache timing.
Related runbooks: identity/cache-invalidation-runbook (linked below) — suggests increasing cache-coherency window or adding optimistic read with fallback to trusted source.
comments: Maya Patel (Reporter) 2026-03-10: Customer-facing impact is internal only but several oncall alerts fired from scheduled query failures. Noticed pattern coincident with AD bridge nightly window.
Jonah Ruiz (Assignee) 2026-03-10: Logged reproducer in staging. Confirmed race condition between scim-sync worker and identity-cache TTL. Will instrument additional logs and add temporary mitigation.

SRE - Lina 2026-03-11: Temporary mitigation deployed: we adjusted identity-cache to prefer last-known-good claims for 10 minutes after SCIM writes, and throttled scim-sync worker concurrency. Monitoring for recurrence.
Infra - Arjun 2026-03-11: We also added a metric to track 'role-claim-empty-after-sync' and a dashboard panel; initial spike matches the incident window. No further escalations so far.

Jonah Ruiz 2026-03-12: Working on durable fix: change scim-sync to use atomic attribute replace semantics and emit pre/post snapshots; update role-mapper to consult Okta API fallback when encountering empty group set immediately after a write. Planning PR today.
resolution: Temporary mitigations applied: increased identity-cache grace window and limited scim-sync concurrency. Root cause: race where SCIM writes briefly cleared 'oktaGroups' attribute and role-mapper treated empty set as authoritative. Next steps: (1) land PR to make scim-sync use safe atomic replace + pre/post snapshots, (2) update role-mapper to consult Okta read-after-write when encountering empty group claims within 2 minutes of a write, (3) add alerting for 'role-claim-empty-after-sync' and include runbook. Targeted deployment of permanent fix: 2026-03-18.
